subject: An API-to-spreadsheet partner prospect for JSON Support
body:
Hi Jonathan,

I saw JSON Support’s FirstUsers introduction and your current API/webhook offering. I prepared a free example of a business that already delivers the kind of workflow your conversion service could fit.

SmoothWork publishes an API integration service that collects data and builds reports, plus an n8n HTTP-request guide. Its named automation consultant is Milan, and its published business contact is hello@smoothwork.ai. A useful introduction would compare one small JSON-to-XLSX delivery step with its existing reporting workflow.

The attached profile and editable CSV include the original pages, current workflow, a suggested opening and what to qualify before a pilot. I have five additional distinct automation or spreadsheet-service profiles prepared for US$20 total. Each includes a published business contact and a specific fit assessment; one correction or replacement is included within seven days for an existing customer, duplicate, dead published contact or clear mismatch.

Would this kind of researched partner list be useful for JSON Support?

Bryce
Token Junkie Labs
